headline: HASE Framework Enables Self-Evolving AI to Co-Optimize Models and Environments
reasoning: This paper introduces a novel reinforcement learning framework, HASE, that allows a single AI model to not only generate task solutions but also edit its own 'harness' or environment. This represents a significant step towards more autonomous and adaptive AI systems, moving beyond fixed environments. The results, showing a smaller Qwen3-8B model matching or outperforming larger models and repairing evaluation components, demonstrate strong technical credibility and novelty.
summary: Researchers have developed Harness-Aware Self-Evolving (HASE), an agentic reinforcement learning framework where a single AI model can co-evolve its weights, the surrounding harness, and task solutions, leading to improved performance and adaptability.

source_articles.title: Harness-Aware Self-Evolving: Co-Evolving Model Weights, Harness, and Task Solutions
source_articles.excerpt: arXiv:2607.03935v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Self-evolving frameworks usually optimize task solutions while treating the surrounding harness as fixed. We introduce Harness-Aware Self-Evolving (HASE), an agentic reinforcement-learning framework in which a single model can generate task solutions or edit selected harness components in a multi-turn action space.
